findings.title: Committed config requires absent AlphaEarth data
findings.detail: deepcal.yaml sets task_niche_prior, family_alphaearth_expert, alphaearth_geo; task_niche_prior crashes (KeyError alphaearth) on the public data zip, and orthogonal_blank_hidden: 512 chains a second hard requirement. Runnable only after recipes/extract_alphaearth.py.

findings.title: Prebuilt CUDA kernel stale vs source
findings.detail: The committed hashencoder_cuda.so forward-passes but crashes training: hash_encode_backward() signature mismatch with current bindings. Fresh clones cannot train until encoders/spacetime/install.sh rebuilds it.

findings.title: Package import requires parent-dir layout
findings.detail: All code imports deepearth.* absolutely with no pip packaging; the clone's parent directory must be on sys.path and the directory must be named deepearth. dashboard/tracker.py handles this for training runs.

findings.title: R27 remediation loss ineffective, not just disabled
findings.detail: Cross-tree transfer fails (B55 0.045 vs 0.216 phylo-oracle) and the shipped fix does not fix it: enabling poll_phylo_weight=0.5 (run dash-r27-poll05, single seed, no-AlphaEarth variant, 2291 steps) left B55 flat (0.045->0.044) and B59 flat, improved pollinator calibration (B53 +0.030, B54 +0.018), cost 43% wall-clock. The self-distillation target (model's own full-info posterior) appears too weak; the mechanism needs redesign, e.g. supervising the relatives-path against GloBI ground truth.

findings.title: Dead and stale code in champion path
findings.detail: R15 memory bank (set_memory/experience) is never called; phylogenomic.py module self-test fails on a stale no-mask assertion; both mislead readers about live capability.

findings.title: Model shape depends on prepared-cache vs fresh assembly
findings.detail: A model built from the prepared_*.pt cache omitted pollinator_graph while a fresh data assembly (identical yaml) instantiates it — checkpoints then fail strict load across the two paths. Same config should always build the same module tree.
